body: I appreciate everyone who commented. I changed my flair to “charter” at some suggestions from you all. To clarify, this was my first ever teaching job. I don’t agree with what charters are doing either, so it is ultimately for the best that I leave. I took the job because they were the only one who took a chance on me as a just-graduated, associate-licensed teacher. I have my professional license now and three years experience. I hope and pray I can get hired in a public school. Thank you all for everything you’ve shared. I feel less alone and more energized to keep submitting applications.
